note: Kice spec §9/§10/§11/§21/§29 (major-update-spec). The guaranteed major rival is the first rival (stage 2), made into a full rival record. Characters are semi-canon: each keeps Pokémon from its canonical teams (Gen 1 Blue/Gary, Gen 2 Silver, Gen 4 Barry, Gen 8 Hop), evolved and levelled to this game. Pools are families (first stages); the starter comes from the first-rival roll. Numbers below are the rules for studied moves, counter moves, Pokémon rivals and the sacrifice event.

lines.intro: Smell ya later? Nope. {rival} wants a rematch, and {ace} is first in line.
lines.studied: {rival} has been replaying your {move}. Now {ace} uses it too.
lines.counter: {rival} trained {ace} for one job: {move} for your {target}.

lines.intro: {rival} brought a cheering section. {ace} soaks it up.
lines.studied: {rival} copied your {move} and calls it his own now.
lines.counter: "Your {target} won't embarrass me twice," says {rival}. {ace} knows {move}.

lines.intro: {rival} glares. {ace} is stronger than last time, and wants you to know it.
lines.studied: {rival} took your {move} for himself. Strength is strength.
lines.counter: {rival} only cares about beating your {target}. {ace} learned {move} for it.

lines.intro: {rival} runs in late and fines you anyway. {ace} is ready!
lines.studied: {rival} practiced your {move} a thousand times. {ace} has it now!
lines.counter: {rival} drew up a plan just for your {target}: {move}!

lines.intro: {rival} grins. "{ace} and I have been training nonstop, mate!"
lines.studied: {rival} loved your {move} so much that {ace} learned it.
lines.counter: {rival} studied your {target} all week. {ace} answers with {move}.

monRival.note: Persistent Pokémon rivalries (§11): one wild individual per run at a time; it takes the first wild battle of each later stage, can't be caught, and a hostile trainer rival may catch it and then always carries it.

sacrifice.note: §29: rare and only when every condition holds. The rival Pokémon (caught by a trainer) is that trainer's last Pokémon in reserve, and the attacker's hit would knock out its rival. Armed per battle by a seeded roll of its own.
